skins.name: 深鲸管理器
skins.author: Small-tailqwq
skins.mutexZh: 本条目为皮肤切换管理器：client-ui 皮肤之间互斥，经管理器统一切换，请勿叠装多个皮肤。已装 @linxin666/dsh-web-all 的环境请使用其皮肤中心适配版，不能叠装 standalone 版。
skins.mutexEn: This entry is the skin switch manager: client-ui skins are mutually exclusive and switched via the manager; do not stack multiple skins. On hosts with @linxin666/dsh-web-all installed, use its skin-center adapter build instead of this standalone package.
skins.notesZh: 深鲸系列皮肤切换管理器（社区 @smalltailqwq 版），提供皮肤面板与统一切换入口。
skins.notesEn: Deep-whale series skin manager (community edition by @smalltailqwq) providing a skin panel and unified switcher.

skins.name: 深海女仆工坊
skins.author: Small-tailqwq
skins.mutexZh: 同皮肤新旧两版互斥（旧 @dsh-external 0.0.1 已退役）：不可与旧版叠装。client-ui 皮肤之间互斥，不可叠装（deep-whale-manager 为统一切换管理器）。已装 @linxin666/dsh-web-all 的环境请使用其皮肤中心适配版，不能叠装 standalone 版。
skins.mutexEn: Old and new builds of this skin are mutually exclusive (legacy @dsh-external 0.0.1 is retired); do not stack them. client-ui skins are mutually exclusive and must not be stacked (deep-whale-manager is the unified switcher). On hosts with @linxin666/dsh-web-all installed, use its skin-center adapter build instead of this standalone package.
